201.sa: हत्वा तु तं भीमबलं विराधं राक्षसं वने। ततस्सीतां परिष्वज्य समाश्वास्य च वीर्यवान्।।3.5.1।। अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं रामो भ्रातरं दीप्ततेजसम्।
201.e: On killing Viradha, the demon of terrific strength, heroic Rama embraced Sita, consoled her and said to his brother Lakshmana, glowing like fire:

201.sa: कष्टं वनमिदं दुर्गं न च स्म वनगोचराः।।3.5.2।। अभिगच्छामहे शीघ्रं शरभङ्गं तपोधनम्।
201.e: This wild forest with which we have not been acquainted earlier is difficult  to pass. (Hence) let us proceed quickly to sage Sarabhanga.

201.sa: आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
201.e: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

201.sa: आश्रमं शरभङ्गस्य राघवोऽभिजगाम ह।।3.5.3।। तस्य देवप्रभावस्य तपसा भावितात्मनः। समीपे शरभङ्गस्य ददर्श महदद्भुतम्।।3.5.4।।
201.e: Rama went to the hermitage of Sarabhanga, a sage with divine grace who had realised the supreme (by his penance). Thus by the side of the sage he witnessed a huge wonder.

201.sa: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
201.e: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

201.sa: विभ्राजमानं वपुषा सूर्यवैश्वानरोपमम्। अवरुह्यरथोत्सङ्गादाकाशे विबुधानुगम।।3.5.5।। असंस्पृशन्तं वसुधां ददर्श विबुधेश्वरम्। सुप्रभाभरणं देवं विरजोऽम्बरधारिणम्।।3.5.6।। तद्विधैरेव बहुभिः पूज्यमानं महात्मभिः।
201.e: Rama saw the lord of the gods (Indra) in the sky getting off the chariot, with his body shining brightly like the sun or the fire, followed by the gods, his feet untouched by the earth. Clad in spotless attire and adorned with shining ornaments, he was being worshipped by many greatsouls like him.

201.sa: हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
201.e: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

201.sa: हरिभिर्वाजिभिर्युक्तमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.7।। ददर्शादूरतस्तस्य तरुणादित्यसन्निभम्। पाण्डुराभ्रघनप्रख्यं चन्द्रमण्डलसन्निभम्।।3.5.8।।
201.e: Not far from that place, Rama saw a chariot, yoked with tawnycoloured horses, shining like the morning  Sun. It looked like a palewhite cloud, resembling the lunar orb.

201.sa: अपश्यद्विमलं छत्रं चित्रमाल्योपशोभितम्। चामरव्यजने चाग्र्ये रुक्मदण्डे महाधने।।3.5.9।। गृहीते वरनारीभ्यां धूयमाने च मूर्धनि।
201.e: Rama saw a pure white umbrella with a highly expensive golden staff, decorated with variegated flower garlands.While near his (Indra's) head stood a pair of exquisite ladies with fans made of yak's tail.

201.sa: गन्धर्वामरसिद्धाश्च बहवः परमर्षयः।।3.5.10।। अन्तरिक्षगतं देवं वाग्भिरग्य्राभिरीडिरे।
201.e: Many celestial singers of heaven, gods, great sages and siddhas sang with the choicest words the glory of this god stationed in the sky.

201.sa: सह सम्भाषमाणे तु शरभङ्गेन वासवे।।3.5.11।। दृष्ट्वा शतक्रतुं तत्र रामो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
201.e: While Indra was conversing with Sarabhanga, Rama saw him and said to Lakshmana.

201.sa: रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
201.e: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

201.sa: रामोऽथ रथमुद्दिश्य लक्ष्मणायप्रदर्शयन्।।3.5.12।। अर्चिष्मन्तं श्रिया जुष्टमद्भुतं पश्य लक्ष्मण। प्रतपन्तमिवादित्यमन्तरिक्षगतं रथम्।।3.5.13।।
201.e: Pointing at the chariot, Rama said, Lakshmana, see this wonderful, effulgent chariot endowed with grace is shining like the Sun in the sky.

201.sa: ये हयाः पुरुहूतस्य पुरा शक्रस्य नश्श्रुताः। अन्तरिक्षगता दिव्यास्त इमे हरयो ध्रुवम्।।3.5.14।।
201.e: The horses of Indra, who is often invoked (during sacrificial rituals) and about whom  we have heard earlier, are now stationed in the sky.

201.sa: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
201.e: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

201.sa: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
201.e: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

201.sa: इमे च पुरुषव्याघ्रा ये तिष्ठ्न्त्यभितो रथम्। शतं शतं कुण्डलिनो युवानः खङ्गपाणयः।।3.5.15।। विस्तीर्णविपुलोरस्काः परिघायतबाहवः। शोणांशुवसनास्सर्वे व्याध्रा इव दुरासदाः।।3.5.16।। उरोदेशेषु सर्वेषां हारा ज्वलनसन्निभाः। रूपं बिभ्रति सौमित्रे पञ्चविंशतिवार्षिकम्।।3.5.17।।
201.e: O Lakshmana  around the chariot stand hundreds of finest young men of about twentyfive years. Clad in red robes, they are wearing earrings, and holding swords in their hands. They have broad chests and stout arms like iron beams. Like tigers, they are difficult to overpower. They have necklaces hanging on their chests blazing like fire.

201.sa: एतद्दि किल देवानां वयो भवति नित्यदा। यथेमे पुरुषव्याघ्रा दृश्यन्ते प्रियदर्शनाः।।3.5.18।।
201.e: These tigers among men have cheerful countenacess from which it can be deduced that the age of the gods always remains constant.

201.sa: इहैव सह वैदेह्या मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ लक्ष्मण। यावज्जानाम्यहं व्यक्तं क एष द्युतिमान्रथे।।3.5.19।।
201.e: Lakshmana, stay here with Sita awhile, until I ascertain who this dazzling being on the chariot is.

201.sa: तमेवमुक्त्वा सौमित्रिमिहैव स्थीयतामिति। अभिचक्राम काकुत्स्थ श्शरभङ्गाश्रमं प्रति।।3.5.20।।
201.e: Instructing Lakshmana to wait , Rama  went towards Sarabhanga's hermitage.

201.sa: ततस्समभिगच्छन्तं प्रेक्ष्य रामं शचीपतिः। शरभङ्गमनुप्राप्य विविक्त इदमब्रवीत्।।3.5.21।।
201.e: Then Indra (husband of Sachi) having seen Rama coming towards him, approached Sarabhanga and said this to him privately:

201.sa: इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयतु तावत्तु ततो मा द्रष्टुमर्हति।।3.5.22।। जितवन्तं कृतार्थं हि तदाहमचिरादिमम्। कर्म ह्यनेन कर्तव्यं महदन्यैस्सुदुष्करम्।।3.5.23।।
201.e: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.

201.sa: इहोपयात्यसौ रामो यावन्मां नाभिभाषते। निष्ठां नयतु तावत्तु ततो मा द्रष्टुमर्हति।।3.5.22।। जितवन्तं कृतार्थं हि तदाहमचिरादिमम्। कर्म ह्यनेन कर्तव्यं महदन्यैस्सुदुष्करम्।।3.5.23।।
201.e: Here comes Rama. Before he talks to me, take me to some other place from where he may not be able to see me. He has to do a great task which is difficult for others. I can see him when he accomplishes the taste and emerges victorious.

201.sa: इति वज्री तमामन्त्र्य मानयित्वा च तापसम्। रथेन हययुक्तेन ययौ दिवमरिन्दमः।।3.5.24।।
201.e: This way honouring the sage Indra, wielder of the thunderbolt, took leave of him and went to heaven in his chariot harressed with horses.

201.sa: प्रयाते तु सहस्राक्षे राघवस्सपरिच्छदः। अग्निहोत्रमुपासीनं शरभङ्गमुपागमत्।।3.5.25।।
201.e: When Indra departed like that, Rama with his retinue (Sita and Lakshmana) went to Sarabhanga who was sitting by the side of the firealtar (for Agnihotra).

201.sa: तस्य पादौ च सङ्गृह्य रामस्सीता च लक्ष्मणः। निषेदुस्समनुज्ञाता लब्धवासा निमन्त्रिताः।।3.5.26।।
201.e: Rama, Sita and Lakshmana prostrated at Sarabhanga's feet. After being permitted to sit, they were invited to stay there.

201.sa: ततश्शक्रोपयानं तु पर्यपृच्छत्स राघवः। शरभङ्गश्च तत्सर्यं राघवाय न्यवेदयत्।।3.5.27।।
201.e: Thereafter on Rama's query Sarabhanga told him all about Indra's visit:

201.sa: मामेष वरदो राम ब्रह्मलोकं निनीषति। जितमुग्रेण तपसा दुष्प्रापमकृतात्मभिः।।3.5.28।।
201.e: O Rama, Indra, the bestower of boons, wants to take me to the world of Brahma,  earned by me through severe penance which is most difficult to be attained by those devoid of selfrealisation.

201.sa: अहं ज्ञात्वा नरव्याघ्र वर्तमानमदूरतः। ब्रह्मलोकं न गच्छामि त्वामदृष्ट्वा प्रियातिथिम्।।3.5.29।।
201.e: O Rama, the best among men you are a very dear guest to me and knowing that you are near, I will not go to the world of Brahman without seeing you.

201.sa: त्वयाऽहं पुरुषव्याघ्र धार्मिकेण महात्मना। समागम्य गमिष्यामि त्रिदिवं देवसेवितम्।।3.5.30।।
201.e: O Rama, the best of men  (only) after seeing a great, virtuous soul like you shall I go to heaven, the abode of the gods.

201.sa: अक्षया नरशार्दूल मया लोका जिताश्शुभा। ब्राह्म्याश्च नाकपृष्ठ्याश्च प्रतिगृह्णीष्व मामकान्।।3.5.31।।
201.e: O tiger among men, I have conquered heavenly abodes as well as the imperishable, auspicious worlds of Brahma. Accept them all that are mine (obtained through my penance)

201.sa: एवमुक्तो नरव्याघ्रस्सर्वशास्त्र विशारदः। ऋषिणा शरभङ्गेण राघवो वाक्यमब्रवीत्।।3.5.32।।
201.e: To these words of sage Sarabhanga Rama, the best of men, the knower of all sastras, the scion of the Raghus replied:

201.sa: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वांल्लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.5.33।।
201.e: O great sage, I will earn all the worlds myself if you direct me. But I need a proper dwellingplace in this forest.

201.sa: राघवेणैवमुक्तस्तु शक्रतुल्यबलेन वै। शरभङ्गो महाप्राज्ञः पुनरेवाब्रवीद्वचः।।3.5.34।।
201.e: To this request of Rama who was equal to Indra in strength, sagacious Sarabhanga said these words:

201.sa: इह राम महातेजास्सुतीक्ष्णो नाम धार्मिकः। वसत्यरण्ये धर्मात्मा स ते श्रेयो विधास्यति।।3.5.35।।
201.e: Here dwells in this forest a brilliant saint, righteous and selfcontrolled, Sutikshna by name who will look to your welfare, O Rama

201.sa: सुतीक्ष्णमभिगच्छ त्वं शुचौ देशे तपस्विनम्। रमणीये वनोद्देशे स ते वासं विधास्यति।।3.5.36।।
201.e: You may approach sage, Sutikshna residing in a sacred spot. He will provide you a delightful place for your stay in the forest.

201.sa: इमां मन्दाकिनीं राम प्रतिस्रोतामनुव्रज। नदीं पुष्पोडुपवहां ततस्तत्र गमिष्यसि।।3.5.37।।
201.e: Proceed, O Rama  in the reverse direction of the river Mandakini carrying flowers and floats. And you will reach the place.

201.sa: एष पन्था नरव्याघ्र मुहूर्तं पश्य तात माम्। यावज्जहामि गात्राणि जीर्णां त्वचमिवोरगः।।3.5.38।।
201.e: O Rama, the best among men, this is the way. Look at me for a while, my dear, until I shed my limbs just as a snake sheds its withered slough.

201.sa: ततोऽग्निं स समाधाय हुत्वा चाज्येन मन्त्रवित्। शरभङ्गो महातेजाः प्रविवेश हुताशनम्।।3.5.39।।
201.e: Then the effulgent Sarabhanga, knower of mantras (magical spells) kindled the fire with faggots and after offering oblations of ghee plunged in.

201.sa: तस्य रोमाणि केशांश्च तदा वह्निर्महात्मनः। जीर्णां त्वचं तथाऽस्थीनि यच्च मांसं सशोणितम्।।3.5.40।।
201.e: Then were consumed that highsouled Sarabhanga's hair on the body and on the head, the wornout skin, the bones and flesh along with blood.

201.sa: स च पावकसङ्काशः कुमारस्समपद्यत। उत्थायाग्निचयात्तस्माच्छरभङ्गो व्यरोचत।।3.5.41।।
201.e: Sarabhanga then emerged youthful from that heap of fire, shining like a flame and looking very elegant৷৷

201.sa: स लोकानाहिताग्नीनामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। देवानां च व्यतिक्रम्य ब्रह्मलोकं व्यरोहत।।3.5.42।।
201.e: Sarabhanga then went beyond the worlds of the gods, of the great sages who constantly kindle sacrificial fire, and ascended to the world of Brahman.

201.sa: स पुण्यकर्मा भुवने द्विजर्षभः पितामहं सानुचरं ददर्श ह। पितामहश्चापि समीक्ष्य तं द्विजं ननन्द सुस्वागतमित्युवाच ह।।3.5.43।।
201.e: Sarabhanga, performer of sacred deeds, saw Brahma with his followers৷৷ Brahma also seeing Sarabhanga, the best among the brahmins,  welcomed him gladly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे पञ्चमः सर्गः।। Thus ends the fifth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

202.sa: शरभङ्गे दिवं प्राप्ते मुनिसङ्घास्समागताः। अभ्यगच्छन्त काकुत्स्थं रामं ज्वलिततेजसम्।।3.6.1।।
202.e: When Sarabhanga attained the heaven, all the sages collected together and came to Rama whose radiance was like fire.

202.sa: वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जकाः परे। गात्रशय्या अशय्याश्च तथैवाभ्रावकाशकाः।।3.6.3।। मुनयस्सलिलाहारावायुभक्षा स्तथापरे। आकाशनिलयाश्चैव तथा स्थण्डिलशायिनः।।3.6.4।। व्रतोपवासिनो दान्तास्तथाऽर्द्रपटवाससः। सजपाश्च तपोनित्यास्तथा पञ्चतपोऽन्विताः।।3.6.5।। सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया जुष्टा दृढयोगास्समाहिताः। शरभङ्गाश्रमे राममभिजग्मुश्च तापसाः।।3.6.6।।
202.e: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

202.sa: वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जकाः परे। गात्रशय्या अशय्याश्च तथैवाभ्रावकाशकाः।।3.6.3।। मुनयस्सलिलाहारावायुभक्षा स्तथापरे। आकाशनिलयाश्चैव तथा स्थण्डिलशायिनः।।3.6.4।। व्रतोपवासिनो दान्तास्तथाऽर्द्रपटवाससः। सजपाश्च तपोनित्यास्तथा पञ्चतपोऽन्विताः।।3.6.5।। सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया जुष्टा दृढयोगास्समाहिताः। शरभङ्गाश्रमे राममभिजग्मुश्च तापसाः।।3.6.6।।
202.e: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

202.e: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

202.sa: वैखानसा वालखिल्यास्सम्प्रक्षाला मरीचिपाः। अश्मकुट्टाश्च बहवः पत्राहाराश्च तापसाः।।3.6.2।। दन्तोलूखलिनश्चैव तथैवोन्मज्जकाः परे। गात्रशय्या अशय्याश्च तथैवाभ्रावकाशकाः।।3.6.3।। मुनयस्सलिलाहारावायुभक्षा स्तथापरे। आकाशनिलयाश्चैव तथा स्थण्डिलशायिनः।।3.6.4।। व्रतोपवासिनो दान्तास्तथाऽर्द्रपटवाससः। सजपाश्च तपोनित्यास्तथा पञ्चतपोऽन्विताः।।3.6.5।। सर्वे ब्राह्म्या श्रिया जुष्टा दृढयोगास्समाहिताः। शरभङ्गाश्रमे राममभिजग्मुश्च तापसाः।।3.6.6।।
202.e: Vaikhanasas, Valakhilyas, sages who continuously wash their bodies, Marichakas Asmakuttas sages who live on leaves only, those who have teeth like mortar, Unmajjakas, those who use limbs as their bed, those who practise penance without using a bed, those who do penance in the open, unmindful of rain or Sun or wind, those who live on water only, those who penance under the open sky, those who carry on penance on high places like the mountaintop, those who recline on bare ground only, those who observe fast as a part of religious tradition, those selfrestrained men, those who mutter sacred mantras, those who constantly perform penance and those who stand under the blazing Sun in summer placing fire on four sides while performing penanceall these types of sages met Rama in the hermitage of Sarabhanga.

202.sa: अभिगम्य च धर्मज्ञा रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। ऊचुः परमधर्मज्ञमृषिसङ्घास्समाहिताः।।3.6.7।।
202.e: All groups of sages, who knew dharma, and were upholders of righteousness reached Rama, the supreme knower of dharma, and said:

202.sa: त्वमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्यास्य पृथिव्याश्च महारथ। प्रधानश्चासि नाथश्च देवानां मघवानिव।।3.6.8।।
202.e: O great charioteer you are the lord of the Ikshvaku race and of the world just like Indra, chief among the gods.

202.sa: विश्रुतस्त्रिषु लोकेषु यशसा विक्रमेण च। पितृभक्तिश्च सत्यं च त्वयि धर्मश्च पुष्कलः।।3.6.9।।
202.e: You are renowned in the three worlds for your valour, for your devotion to father, and in you lies enough evidence of your adherence to truth and righteousness.

202.sa: त्वामासाद्य महात्मानं धर्मज्ञं धर्मवत्सलम्। अर्थित्वान्नाथ वक्ष्यामस्तच्च नः क्षन्तुमर्हसि।।3.6.10।।
202.e: O lord, do excuse us. We sought your help to fulfil our needs since you are at hand. You are a great soul, knower and lover of dharma.

202.sa: अधर्मस्सुमहांस्तात भवेत्तस्य महीपतेः। यो हरेद्बलिषड्भागां न च रक्षति पुत्रवत्।।3.6.11।।
202.e: O Lord, a king who collect one sixth of the produce as tax and yet does not protect his subjects like his children commits an act of grave injustice.

202.sa: युञ्जानस्स्वानिव प्राणान्प्राणैरिष्टान्सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तस्सदा रक्षन्सर्वान्विषयवासिनः।।3.6.12।। प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीं राम कीर्तिं स बहुवार्षिकीम्। ब्रह्मणस्स्थानमासाद्य तत्र चापि महीयते।।3.6.13।।
202.e: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.

202.sa: युञ्जानस्स्वानिव प्राणान्प्राणैरिष्टान्सुतानिव। नित्ययुक्तस्सदा रक्षन्सर्वान्विषयवासिनः।।3.6.12।। प्राप्नोति शाश्वतीं राम कीर्तिं स बहुवार्षिकीम्। ब्रह्मणस्स्थानमासाद्य तत्र चापि महीयते।।3.6.13।।
202.e: O Rama, whoever protects the inhabitants of his kingdom at all times like his own son who he loves more than his own life will attain the world of Brahma and remain there for long years and will achieve prosperity thereafter.

202.sa: यत्करोति परं धर्म मुनिर्मूलफलाशनः। तत्र राज्ञश्चतुर्भाग प्रजा धर्मेण रक्षितः।।3.6.14।।
202.e: One fourth of the supreme merit a sage earns by living on fruits and roots, accrues to the king through which the people are protected righteously.

202.sa: सोऽयं ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठो वानप्रस्थगणो महान्। त्वन्नाथोऽनाथवद्राम राक्षसैर्वध्यते भृशम्।।3.6.15।।
202.e: O Rama  we are a group of great sages, mostly brahmins, leading a vanaprastha  life. Yet with a protector like you, we are slaughtered in large numbers like orphans.

202.sa: एहि पश्य शरीराणि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम्। हतानां राक्षसैर्घोरैर्बहूनां बहुधा वने।।3.6.16।।
202.e: Come and see  the bodies of ascetics, who had perceived the Supreme Spirit, killed in large numbers in the forest by the fierce demons.

202.sa: पम्पानदीनिवासानामनुमन्दाकिनीमपि। चित्रकूटालयानां च क्रियते कदनं महत्।।3.6.17।।
202.e: A great slaughter is taking place amongst those residing on the bank of the Pampa lake, near the river Mandakini, and on mount Chitrakuta.

202.sa: एवं वयं न मृष्यामो विप्रकारं तपस्विनाम्। क्रियमाणं वने घोरं रक्षोभिर्भीमकर्मभिः।।3.6.18।।
202.e: We ascetics are not able to tolerate the fearful deeds perpetrated by the dreadful demons in the forest.

202.sa: ततस्त्वां शरणार्थं च शरण्यं समुपस्थिताः। परिपालय नो राम वध्यमानान्निशाचरैः।।3.6.19।।
202.e: O Rama, you are worthy of refuge. Hence we have come to you seeking your protection. We are being killed by the nightstalkers. Save us.

202.sa: परा त्वत्तो गतिर्वीर पृथिव्यां नोपपद्यते। परिपालय न स्सर्वान्राक्षसेभ्यो नृपात्मज।।3.6.20।।
202.e: O great warrior here on this earth there is no protector as mighty as you. So, O prince  save us all from these demons.

202.sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु काकुत्स्थस्तापसानां तपस्विनाम्। इदं प्रोवाच धर्मात्मा सर्वानेव तपस्विनः।।3.6.21।।
202.e: Having heard this, righteous Rama of the Kakutstha dynasty said to all the ascetics engaged in penance:

202.sa: नैवमर्हथ मां वक्तुमाज्ञाप्योऽहं तपस्विनाम्। केवलेनात्मकार्येण प्रवेष्टव्यं मया वनं।।3.6.22।।
202.e: You should not speak to me this way. I deserve to be commanded by the ascetics. I have not entered this forest only on a personal mission.

202.sa: विप्रकारमपाक्रष्टुं राक्षसैर्भवतामिमम्। पितुस्तु निर्देशकरः प्रविष्टोऽहमिदं वनम्।।3.6.23।।
202.e: I came into this forest in obedience to my father's orders to repel the aggression of demons against you.

202.sa: भवतामर्थसिद्ध्यर्थमागतोऽहं यदृच्छया। तस्य मेऽयं वने वासो भविष्यति महाफलः।।3.6.24।।
202.e: I came here to acomplish your task incidentally, Therefore, my stay in the forest will yield great results.

202.sa: तपस्विनां रणे शत्रून्हन्तुमिच्छामि राक्षसान्। पश्यन्तु वीर्यमृषयस्सभ्रातुर्मे तपोधनाः।।3.6.25।।
202.e: I wish to kill in the fight the demons who are your enemies. O great ascetics, you may  witness my prowess supported by my brother.

202.sa: दत्त्वाऽभयं चापि तपोधनानां धर्मे धृतात्मा सह लक्ष्मणेन। तपोधनैश्चापि सभाज्यवृत्तः सुतीक्ष्णमेवाभिजगाम वीरः।।3.6.26।।
202.e: Brave Rama, steadfast in righteousness, worthy of honour, gave assurance to protect the ascetics endowed with the wealth of penance, and proceeded towards sage Sutikshna. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे षष्ठस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the sixth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

203.sa: रामस्तु सहितो भ्रात्रा सीतया च परन्तपः। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमपदं जगाम सह तैर्द्विजैः।।3.7.1।।
203.e: Rama, the scorcher of enemies, along with his brother Lakshmana and Sita and the sages went to Sutikshna's hermitage.

203.sa: स गत्वा दीर्घमध्वानं नदीस्तीर्त्वा बहूदकाः। ददर्श विमलं शैलं महामेघमिवोन्नतम्।।3.7.2।।
203.e: After covering a long distance and crossing the river (Ganga) with plenty of water, Rama saw a huge mountain looking like a lofty cloud.

203.sa: तत स्तदिक्ष्वाकुवरौ सन्ततं विविधैर्द्रुमैः। काननं तौ विविशतुस्सीतया सह राघवौ।।3.7.3।।
203.e: Rama and Lakshmana, the best of the Ikshvaku family, accompanied by Sita entered the dense forest  filled with trees all over.

203.sa: प्रविष्टस्तु वनं घोरं बहुपुष्पफलद्रुमम्। ददर्शाश्रममेकान्ते चीरमालापरिष्कृतम्।।3.7.4।।
203.e: Entering that dreadful forest, they saw trees full of flowers and fruits, and a hermitage in a lonely place with lines of bark robes hanging.

203.sa: तत्र तापसमासीनं मलपङ्कजटाधरम्। रामस्सुतीक्ष्णं विधिवत्तपोवृद्धमभाषत।।3.7.5।।
203.e: There at the hermitage was Sutikshna, an ascetic grown old with (long) penance, wearing soiled, matted locks and seated. Rama (first) addressed him as per custom.

203.sa: रामोऽहमस्मि भगवन्भवन्तं द्रष्टुमागतः। त्वं माभिवद धर्मज्ञ महर्षे सत्यविक्रम।।3.7.6।।
203.e: O venerable one, I am Rama.You are a great sage, armed with truth as your prowess and a knower of dharma. I have come to see you. Could you speak to me?

203.sa: स निरीक्ष्य ततो धीरो रामं धर्मभृतां वरम्। समाश्लिष्य च बाहुभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.7.7।।
203.e: Thereafter the composed Sutikshna, looked at Rama, the best among righteous men, and embracing him with both his arms said:

203.sa: स्वागतं ते रघुश्रेष्ठ राम सत्यभृतां वर। आश्रमोऽयं त्वयाक्रान्तस्सनाथ इव साम्प्रतम्।।3.7.8।।
203.e: O Rama, the best among the Raghavas and among the upholders of truth, you are welcome. With your presence this hermitage will have a protector now.

203.sa: प्रतीक्षमाणस्त्वामेव नारोहेऽहं महायशः। देवलोकमितो वीर देहं त्यक्त्वा महीतले। चित्रकूटमुपादाय राज्यभ्रष्टोऽसि मे श्रुतः।।3.7.9।।
203.e: O renowned hero, I had heard that you have come to Chitrakuta, renouncing your kingdom. I have been waiting so long to see you here. Unable to give up this body, I did not even leave the earth for heaven, the world of the gods.

203.sa: इहोपयातः काकुत्थ्स देवराजश्शतक्रतुः।।3.7.10।। उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवस्सुरेश्वरः। सर्वान् लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा।।3.7.11।।
203.e: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

203.sa: इहोपयातः काकुत्थ्स देवराजश्शतक्रतुः।।3.7.10।। उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवस्सुरेश्वरः। सर्वान् लोकाञ्जितानाह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा।।3.7.11।।
203.e: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.

203.sa: तेषु देवर्षिजुष्टेषु जितेषु तपसा मया। मत्प्रसादात्सभार्यस्त्वं विहरस्व सलक्ष्मणः।।3.7.12।।
203.e: Along with your wife and Lakshmana you may roam by my grace the worlds won by me and served by divine sages like devarsi Narada.

203.sa: तमुग्रतपसायुक्तं महर्षिं सत्यवादिनम्। प्रत्युवाचात्मवान्रामो ब्रह्माणमिव काश्यपः।।3.7.13।।
203.e: Selfpossessed Rama replied to the truthful ascetic who had performed intense penance. Just as Kasyapa would address Lord Brahma:

203.sa: अहमेवाहरिष्यामि सर्वान् लोकान्महामुने। आवासं त्वहमिच्छामि प्रदिष्टमिह कानने।।3.7.14।।
203.e: O great sage I will win all the worlds myself. I (only) want to live in this forest. Allow me.

203.sa: भवान्सर्वत्र कुशलस्सर्वभूतहिते रतः। आख्यातश्शरभङ्गेण गौतमेन महात्मना।।3.7.15।।
203.e: You are ever engaged in the welfare of all beings. I have heard this from the great sage Sarabhanga of Gautama's clan.

203.sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण महर्षिर्लोकविश्रुतः। अब्रवीन्मधुरं वाक्यं हर्षेण महताऽप्लुतः।।3.7.16।।
203.e: Thus addressed by  Rama, Sutikshna, the great sage, wellknown to the world was highly delighted. He (then) said these sweet words:

203.sa: अयमेवाश्रमो राम गुणवान्रम्यतामिह। ऋषिसङ्घानुचरितस्सदा मूलफलैर्युतः।।3.7.17।।
203.e: O Rama this is a salubrious hermitage where hosts of sages live and which is full of roots and fruits, you may enjoy yourself here.

203.sa: इममाश्रममागम्य मृगसङ्घा महायशः। अहत्वा प्रतिगच्छन्ति लोभयित्वाऽकुतोभयाः।।3.7.18।।
203.e: O illustrious Rama, herds of animals visit this place fearlessly, enticing the inmates and (then) go back without harming any one.

203.sa: नान्यद्धोषं भवेदत्र मृगेभ्योऽन्यत्र विद्धि वै। तच्छृत्वा वचनं तस्य महर्षेर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजः।।3.7.19।। उवाच वचनं धीरो विकृष्य  सशरं धनुः।
203.e: When heroic Rama heard that there was no other problem from the wild animals except their frequent incursions, he lifted his bow with an arrow and said these words:

203.sa: तानहं सुमहाभाग मृगसङ्घान्समागतान्।।3.7.20।। हन्यां निशितधारेण शरेणाशनिवर्चसा।
203.e: O reverend one, I will kill with a sharpedged arrow, glowing like a thunderbolt, all those herds of animals who keep coming here.

203.sa: भवांस्तत्राभिषज्येत किंस्यात्कृच्छ्रतरं ततः।।3.7.21।। एतस्मिन्नाश्रमे वासं चिरं तु न समर्थये।
203.e: What can be more agonizing for you (than my killing animals). I (therefore) do not foresee our long stay in this hermitage.

203.sa: तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां स्नध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याऽश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च।।3.7.23।।
203.e: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.

203.sa: तमेवमुक्त्वोपरमं रामस्सन्ध्यामुपागमत्।।3.7.22।। अन्वास्य पश्चिमां संंध्यां तत्र वासमकल्पयत्। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमे रम्ये सीतया लक्ष्मणेन च।।3.7.23।।
203.e: Rama stopped with this. And then the evening drew to a close. Offering his evening oblation, he arranged for his stay along with Sita and Lakshmana in the delightful hermitage of Sutikshna.

203.sa: ततश्शुभं तापसभोज्यमन्नं स्वयं सुतीक्ष्णः पुरुषर्षभाभ्याम्। ताभ्यां सुसत्कृत्य ददौ महात्मा सन्ध्यानिवृत्तौ  रजनीं मवेक्ष्य।।3.7.24।।
203.e: Seeing that the evening had passed and night had set in, the great sage Sutikshna with due hospitality, served those best of men, food fit for ascetics. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे सप्तमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the seventh sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

204.sa: रामस्तु सहसौमित्रिस्सुतीक्ष्णेनाभिपूजितः। परिणाम्य निशां तत्र प्रभाते प्रत्यबुध्यत।।3.8.1।।
204.e: Rama, worshipped by Sutikshna and accompanied by Lakshmana, spent the night at the hermitage, and got up early in the morning.

204.sa: उत्थाय तु यथाकालं राघवस्सहसीतया। उपस्पृश्यसुशितेन जलेनोत्पलगन्धिना।।3.8.2।।
204.e: In the morning Rama and Sita got up in time and took bath in cool, lilyfragrant water.

204.sa: अथ तेऽग्निं सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने।।3.8.3।। उदयन्तं दिनकरं दृष्ट्वा विगतकल्मषाः। सुतीक्ष्णभिगम्येदं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रुवन्।।3.8.4।।
204.e: And as per routine, sinless Sita, Rama and Lakshmana offered prayers to the fire and other gods of the forest which was the refuge of the ascetics. Seeing the rising Sun, they worshipped him, and approaching Sutikshna,  said these soothing words:

204.sa: अथ तेऽग्निं सुरांश्चैव वैदेही रामलक्ष्मणौ। काल्यं विधिवदभ्यर्च्य तपस्विशरणे वने।।3.8.3।। उदयन्तं दिनकरं दृष्ट्वा विगतकल्मषाः। सुतीक्ष्णभिगम्येदं श्लक्ष्णं वचनमब्रुवन्।।3.8.4।।
204.e: And as per routine, sinless Sita, Rama and Lakshmana offered prayers to the fire and other gods of the forest which was the refuge of the ascetics. Seeing the rising Sun, they worshipped him, and approaching Sutikshna,  said these soothing words:

204.sa: सुखोषितास्स्मभगवंस्त्वया पूज्येन पूजिताः। आपृच्छामः प्रयास्यामो मुनयस्त्वरयन्ति नः।।3.8.5।।
204.e: O revered Sutikshna received by one so worshipworthy like you, we spent the night well. We (now)take leave of you. The sages  are hastening us.

204.sa: त्वरामहे वयं द्रष्टुं कृत्स्नमाश्रममण्डलम्। ऋषीणां पुण्यशीलानां दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.8.6।।
204.e: We wish to see the entire circle of hermitages of the sages, residing in Dandaka forest. So we are in a hurry.

204.sa: अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामस्सहैभिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः। धर्मनित्यैस्तपोदान्तैर्विशिखैरिव पावकैः।।3.8.7।।
204.e: We seek your permission to go with the great sages, who are ever engaged in righteousness, selfcontrolled by virtue of their penance, and are like flameless fire.

204.sa: अविषह्यातपो यावत्सूर्यो नातिविराजते। अमार्गेणागतां लक्ष्मीं प्राप्येवान्वयवर्जितः।।3.8.8।। तावदिच्छामहे गन्तुमित्युक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः। ववन्दे सहसौमित्रिस्सीतया सह राघवः।। 3.8.9।।
204.e: We wish to depart before the Sun grows unbearably hot like the man devoid of good lineage who acquires wealth through unlawful means (becomes arrogant). Thereafter Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana offered worship at the feet of the venerable sage.

204.sa: अविषह्यातपो यावत्सूर्यो नातिविराजते। अमार्गेणागतां लक्ष्मीं प्राप्येवान्वयवर्जितः।।3.8.8।। तावदिच्छामहे गन्तुमित्युक्त्वा चरणौ मुनेः। ववन्दे सहसौमित्रिस्सीतया सह राघवः।। 3.8.9।।
204.e: We wish to depart before the Sun grows unbearably hot like the man devoid of good lineage who acquires wealth through unlawful means (becomes arrogant). Thereafter Rama along with Sita and Lakshmana offered worship at the feet of the venerable sage.

204.sa: तौ संस्पृशन्तौ चरणावुत्थाप्य मुनिपुङ्गवः। गाढमालिङ्ग्य सस्नेहमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।।3.8.10।।
204.e: When both Rama and Lakshmana touched the feet of Sutikshna, the best of the sages, he lifted them up, hugged them tightly, and said affectionately:

204.sa: अरिष्टं गच्छ पन्थानं राम सौमित्रिणा सह। सीतया चानया सार्धं छाययेवानुवृत्तया।।3.8.11।।
204.e: You may safely tread, O Rama, this path along with Lakshmana and Sita who is following you like a shadow.

204.sa: पश्याश्रमपदं रम्यं दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्। एषां तपस्विनां वीर तपसा भावितात्मनाम्।।3.8.12।।
204.e: O valient Rama the sages, living in  the Dandaka forest, are self realised souls. See how delightful is the location of their hermitages.

204.sa: सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
204.e: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled  with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks  and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

204.sa: सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
204.e: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled  with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks  and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

204.sa: सप्राज्यफलमूलानि पुष्पितानि वनानि च। प्रशस्तमृगयूथानि शान्तपक्षिगणानि च।। 3.8.13।। फुल्लपङ्कजषण्डानि प्रसन्नसलिलानि च। कारण्डवविकीर्णानि तटाकानि सरांसि च।।3.8.14।। द्रक्ष्यसे दृष्टिरम्याणि गिरिप्रस्रवणानि च। रमणीयान्यरण्यानि मयूराभिरुतानि च।।3.8.15।।
204.e: You will see the beautiful forestareas with abundant fruits and roots, flowers in full bloom, herds of animals, flocks of quiet birds tanks and lakes filled  with clean waters and shining with fully blossomed lotuses, resounding with waterducks and peacocks  and waterfalls coming down the hills. Thus you will enjoy a delightful sylvan sight.

204.sa: गम्यतां वत्स सौमित्रे भवानपि च गच्छतु। आगन्तव्यं च ते दृष्ट्वा पुनरेवाश्रमं मम।।3.8.16।।
204.e: O dear Rama, O Lakshmana you may leave (now), you may have to come back to this hermitage after seeing those places.

204.sa: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा काकुत्स्थस्सहलक्ष्मणः। प्रदक्षिणं मुनिं कृत्वा प्रस्थातुमुपचक्रमे।।3.8.17।।
204.e: Thus addressed, Rama, scion of the Kakutsthas along with Lakshmana circumambulated the sage (in reverence) and set forth.

204.sa: ततश्शुभतरे तूणी धनुषी चायतेक्षणा। ददौ सीता तयोर्भ्रात्रोः खङ्गौ च विमलौ ततः।।3.8.18।।
204.e: Thereafter largeeyed Sita handed the brothers two quivers, two bows as well as two excellent swords.

204.sa: आबध्य च शुभे तूणी चापे चादाय सुस्वनौ। निष्क्रान्तावाश्रमाद्गन्तुमुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।।3.8.19।।
204.e: Both Rama and Lakshmana  tied their auspicious quivers, took the two twanging bows and departed from the hermitage.

204.sa: श्रीमन्तौ रूपसम्पन्नौ दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा। प्रस्थितौ धृतचापौ तौ सीतया सह राघवौ।।3.8.20।।
204.e: Handsome Rama and Lakshmana, glowing in their radiance held the bows and exited  with Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे अष्टमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the eighth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.

205.sa: सुतीक्ष्णेनाभ्यनुज्ञातं प्रस्थितं रघुनन्दनम्। हृद्यया स्निग्धया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्।।3.9.1।।
205.e: While Rama was leaving with the permission of Sutikshna, Sita spoke these warm, affectionate words to her husband:

205.sa: अयं धर्मस्सुसूक्ष्मेण विधिना प्राप्यते महान्। निवृत्तेन तु शक्योऽयं व्यसनात्कामजादिह।।3.9.2।।
205.e: This great path of dharma you are following now can be attained only through subtle means by one free from addiction born of passion.

205.sa: त्रीण्येव व्यसनान्यत्र कामजानि भवन्त्युत। मिथ्यावाक्यं परमकं तस्माद्गुरुतरावुभौ।।3.9.3।। परदाराभिगमनं विना वैरं च रौद्रता।
205.e: There are three kinds of vices born out of lust. First, speaking untruth, second, having sexual relation with others' wives and third, resorting to violence with no enmity. The later two vices are of serious nature.

205.sa: मिथ्यावाक्यं न ते भूतं न भविष्यति राघव।।3.9.4।। कुतोऽभिलाषणं स्त्रीणां परेषां धर्मनाशनम्।
205.e: O Rama you never spoke untruth in the past nor will you speak in future. How can there be any desire in you to destroy the virtue of others' wives ?

205.sa: तव नास्ति मनुष्येन्द्र न चाभूत्ते कदाचन।।3.9.5।। मनस्यपि तथा राम न चैतद्विद्यते क्वचित्।
205.e: O Rama, lord among men, you hadn't it (lust for other women) in the past. You havn't it now. Never does it exist even in your mind.

205.sa: स्वदारनिरतस्त्वं च नित्यमेव नृपात्मज।।3.9.6।। धर्मिष्ठस्सत्यसन्धश्च पितुर्निर्देशकारकः।
205.e: O prince, you are always faithful to your wife. You are righteous, truthful and obedient to your father's orders.

205.sa: सत्यसन्ध महाभाग श्रीमल्लक्ष्मणपूर्वज।।3.9.7।। त्वयि धर्मश्च सत्यं च त्वयि सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्।
205.e: O Rama, you are truthful, honourable, powerful. O elder brother of Lakshmana, in you is established truth and righteousness.

205.sa: तच्च सर्वं महाबाहो शक्यं धर्तुं जितेन्द्रियैः।।3.9.8।। तव वश्येन्द्रियत्वं च जानामि शुभदर्शन।
205.e: O longarmed one, to contain all this is only possible for those who have conquered the senses. O handsome one, I know your ability to control the senses.

205.sa: तृतीयं यदिदं रौद्रं परप्राणाभिहिंसनम्।।3.9.9।। निर्वैरं क्रियते मोहात्तच्च ते समुपस्थितम्।
205.e: (But) you are a victim to the third (vice born of lust) i.e. showing violence without cause for enmity

205.sa: प्रतिज्ञातस्त्वया वीर दण्डकारण्यवासिनाम्।।3.9.10।। ऋषीणां रक्षणार्थाय वधस्संयति रक्षसाम्।
205.e: O valiant one, you have promised to kill the demons in the battle, in order to protect the sages residing in the Dandaka forest.

205.sa: एतन्निमित्तं च वनं दण्डका इति विश्रुतम्।।3.9.11।। प्रस्थितस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा धृतबाणशरासनः।
205.e: It is only on account of this that you entered the wellknown Dandaka forest with your brother wielding bow and arrows.

205.sa: ततस्त्वां प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा मम चिन्ताकुलं मनः।।3.9.12।। त्वद्वृत्तं चिन्तयन्त्या वै भवेन्निश्श्रेयसं हितम्।
205.e: I am, therefore, worried in my mind when I see you here and think of your wellbeing. I wish your ultimate good. [The next two lines appear, more or less, a repetition. So omitted : Editor]

205.sa: त्वां चैव प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा राम चिन्ताकुलं मनः।।3.9.13।। सर्वतचशिन्तय्नत्या मे तव निश्श्रेयसं नृप। न हि मे रोचते वीर गमनं दण्डकान्प्रति।।3.9.14।। कारणं तत्र वक्ष्यामि वदन्त्याश्श्रूयतां मम।
205.e: O brave Rama, I do not like your going to Dandaka forest. I shall tell you the reason. Do listen.

205.sa: त्वां चैव प्रस्थितं दृष्ट्वा राम चिन्ताकुलं मनः।।3.9.13।। सर्वतचशिन्तय्नत्या मे तव निश्श्रेयसं नृप। न हि मे रोचते वीर गमनं दण्डकान्प्रति।।3.9.14।। कारणं तत्र वक्ष्यामि वदन्त्याश्श्रूयतां मम।
205.e: O brave Rama, I do not like your going to Dandaka forest. I shall tell you the reason. Do listen.

205.sa: त्वं हि बाणधनुष्पाणिर्भ्रात्रा सह वनं गतः।।3.9.15।। दृष्ट्वा वनचरान्सर्वान्कच्चित्कुर्याश्शरव्ययम्।
205.e: Of course, you will go to the forest with your brother, holding the bow and arrows. Release the arrows when you see the forestrangers.

205.sa: क्षत्रियाणामपि धनुर्हुताशस्येन्धनानि च।।3.9.16।। समीपतस्स्थितं तेजो बलमुच्छ्रयते भृशम्।
205.e: A bow in the hand of a kshatriya is like fuel to fire. It surely swells his strength and his brilliance.

205.sa: पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्स्वी सत्यवाक्छुचिः।।3.9.17।। कस्मिंश्चिदभवत्पुण्ये वने रतमृगद्विजे।
205.e: O mightyarmed one, there dwelt in the past an ascetic, noble and truthful in a sacred forest where animals and birds lived merrily together.

205.sa: तस्यैव तपसो विघ्नं कर्तुमिन्द्रश्शचीपतिः।।3.9.18।। खङ्गपाणिरथागच्छदाश्रमं भटरूपधृत्।
205.e: Once Indra, husband of Sachi, came to his hermitage in the guise of an attendant, sword in hand, in order to hinder his penance.

205.sa: तस्मिंस्तदाश्रमपदे निशितः खङ्ग उत्तमः।।3.9.19।। स न्यासविधिना दत्तः पुण्ये तपसि तिष्ठतः।
205.e: Then while the sage was practising penance at the hermitage, he gave him that excellent sword to be kept in trust.

205.sa: स तच्छस्त्रमनुप्राप्य न्यासरक्षणतत्परः।।3.9.20।। वने तु विचरत्येव रक्षन्प्रत्ययमात्मनः।
205.e: Having received the weapon as a trust, the sage went wandering in the forest, always attentive in safeguarding the weapon.

205.sa: यत्र गच्छत्युपादातुं मूलानि च फलानि च।।3.9.21।। न विना याति तं खङ्गं न्यासरक्षणतत्परः।
205.e: Vigilant about protecting the sword deposited with him, the sage never moved without it even when he went gathering roots and fruits.

205.sa: नित्यं शस्त्रं परिवहन्क्रमेण स तपोधनः।।3.9.22।। चकार रौद्रीं स्वां बुद्धिं त्यक्त्वा तपसि निश्चयम्।
205.e: While the sage moved about holding the weapon, he gave up the practice of penance gradually and developed a violent mindset.

205.sa: ततस्सरौद्रेऽभिरतः प्रमत्तोऽधर्मकर्शितः।।3.9.23।। तस्य शस्त्रस्य संवासाज्जगाम नरकं मुनिः।
205.e: By association with the sword, he developed a violent attitude. And in that habitual state of excitement he was dragged into unrighteous ways which (ultimately) took him to hell.

205.sa: एवमेतत्पुरा वृत्तं शस्त्रसंयोगकारणम्।।3.9.24।। अग्निसंयोगवद्धेतुश्शस्त्रसंयोग उच्यते। स्नेहाच्च बहुमानाच्च स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये।।3.9.25।।
205.e: Contact with the weapon has led to this in the past. Like contact with fire, it leads man to destruction. I say this out of my love and reverence for you as a reminder and not as an instruction.

205.sa: एवमेतत्पुरा वृत्तं शस्त्रसंयोगकारणम्।।3.9.24।। अग्निसंयोगवद्धेतुश्शस्त्रसंयोग उच्यते। स्नेहाच्च बहुमानाच्च स्मारये त्वां न शिक्षये।।3.9.25।।
205.e: Contact with the weapon has led to this in the past. Like contact with fire, it leads man to destruction. I say this out of my love and reverence for you as a reminder and not as an instruction.

205.sa: न कथञ्चन सा कार्या गृहीतधनुषा त्वया। बुद्धिर्वैरं  विना हन्तुं राक्षसान्दण्डकाश्रितान्।।3.9.26।। अपराधं विना हन्तुं लोकान्वीर न कामये।
205.e: While holding a bow, you should not have the intention to kill demons residing in Dandaka with no animosity against you. O valiant one  I do not desire that any one should be killed without incurring any offence.

205.sa: क्षत्रियाणां तु वीराणां वनेषु निरतात्मनाम्।।3.9.27।। धनुषा कार्यमेतावदार्तानां त्वभिरक्षणम्।
205.e: It is the duty of a kshatriya, a warrior to protect with his bow those who practise selfcontrol (penance) in the forest in a state of panic.

205.sa: क्वच शस्त्रं क्व च वनं क्व च क्षात्रं तपः क्वच।।3.9.28।। व्याविद्धमिदमस्माभिर्द्देशधर्मस्तु पूज्यताम्।
205.e: Where is the question of wielding a weapon and living in the forest, where is the life of a kshatriya and the life of penance? For us, this is an encroachment. Let the law of the land be honoured.

205.sa: तदार्य कलुषा बुद्धिर्जायते शस्त्रसेवनात्।।3.9.29।। पुनर्गत्वा त्वयोध्यायां क्षत्रधर्मं चरिष्यसि।
205.e: Lord, when we handle the weapon, the mind gets vitiated. (Only) after returning to Ayodhya can you perform the duty of a kshatriya.

205.sa: अक्षया तु भवेत्प्रीतिश्श्वश्रूश्वशुरयोर्मम।।3.9.30।। यदि राज्यं परित्यज्य भवेस्त्वं निरतो मुनिः।
205.e: You would have been on unlimited source of joy to my fatherinlaw and motherinlaw had you permanently renounced the kingdom for the life of an ascetic.

205.sa: धर्मादर्थः प्रभवति धर्मात्प्रभवते सुखम्।।3.9.31।। धर्मेण लभते सर्वं धर्मसारमिदं जगत्।
205.e: Righteousness brings wealth. Wealth brings happiness. Righteousness brings everything. In fact, the essence of the world is righteousness.

205.sa: आत्मानं नियमैस्तैस्तै कर्शयित्वा प्रयत्नतः।।3.9.32।। प्राप्यते निपुणैर्धर्मो न सुखाल्लभ्यते सुखम्।
205.e: The wise earn dharma through getting their bodies emaciated by carefully adopting different means of discipline (selftorture). Happiness does not beget happiness.

205.sa: नित्यं शुचिमतिस्सौम्य चर धर्मं तपोवने।।3.9.33।। सर्वं हि विदितं तुभ्यं त्रैलोक्यमपि तत्त्वतः।
205.e: O gentle one you may move in this forest of ascetics with a pure mind. The true meaning behind everything in these three worlds is known to you, indeed.

206.sa: वाक्यमेतत्तु वैदेह्या व्याहृतं भर्तृभक्तया। श्रुत्वा धर्मे स्थितो रामः प्रत्युवाचाथ मैथिलीम्।।3.10.1।।
206.e: Having heard these words spoken by Sita who was devoted to her husband, replied Rama who was firm in righteousness.

206.sa: हितमुक्तं त्वया देवि स्निग्धया सदृशं वचः। कुलं व्यपदिशन्त्या च धर्मज्ञे जनकात्मजे।।3.10.2।।
206.e: O daughter of Janaka, you are conversant with dharma. Whatever you have admonished out of affection for me is befitting your race.

206.sa: किन्तु वक्ष्याम्यहं देवि त्वयैवोक्तमिदं वचः। क्षत्रियैर्धार्यते चापो नार्तशब्दो भवेदिति।।3.10.3।।
206.e: But permit me, Devi, you have already stated, when a kshatriya holds a bow there will be no cry of distress. (it means you approve of my holding a bow)

206.sa: ते चार्ता दण्डकारण्ये मुनयस्संशितव्रताः। मां सीते स्वयमागम्य शरण्याश्शरणं गताः।।3.10.4।।
206.e: O Sita, the sages who perform rigorous penance in Dandaka forest came to me personally, seeking shelter although they can be their own protection.

206.sa: वसन्तो धर्मनिरता वने मूलफलाशनाः। न लभन्ते सुखं भीता राक्षसैः क्रूरकर्मभिः।।3.10.5।।
206.e: The sages living in the forest, eating roots and fruits and ever engaged in righteous activities are afraid of the depredations of the demons, with their happiness gone.

206.sa: काले काले च निरता नियमैर्विविधैर्वने। भक्ष्यन्ते राक्षसैर्भीमैर्नरमांसोपजीविभिः।।3.10.6।।
206.e: The sages engrossed in various austerities in the forest have been victims to the dreadful demons living on human flesh.

206.sa: ते भक्ष्यमाणा मुनयो दण्डकारण्यवासिनः। अस्मानभ्यवपद्येति मामूचुर्द्विजसत्तमा।।3.10.7।।
206.e: The ascetics, the best of brahmins living in Dandaka forest being eaten up like that besought me to come to their rescue.

206.sa: मया तु वचनं श्रुत्वा तेषामेवं मुखाच्च्युतम्। कृत्वा चरणशुश्रूषां वाक्यमेतदुदाहृतम्।।3.10.8।।
206.e: On hearing the words that came from their mouth, I bowed at their feet and said:

206.sa: प्रसीदन्तु भवन्तो मे ह्रीरेषा हि ममातुला। यदीदृशैरहं विप्रैरुपस्थेयैरुपस्थितः।।3.10.9।।
206.e: Be pleased  That brahmins like you have approached me while I should have come to you has put me to shame immeasurable .

206.sa: किं करोमीति च मया व्याहृतं द्विजसन्निधौ। सर्वैरेतैस्समागम्य वागियं समुदाहृता।।3.10.10।।
206.e: I enquired about what I could do for them. And all the brahmins in one voice said:.

206.sa: राक्षसैर्दण्डकारण्ये बहुभिः कामरूपिभिः। अर्दितास्स्म दृढं राम भवान्नस्तत्र रक्षतु।।3.10.11।।
206.e: 'O Rama, the demons who can assume any form at their will are mercilessly tormenting us in Dandaka forest. Do protect us from them'.

206.sa: होमकालेषु सम्प्राप्ताः पर्वकालेषु चानघ। धर्षयन्ति सुदुर्धर्षा राक्षसाः पिशिताशनाः।।3.10.12।।
206.e: 'O sinless one, these cannibals are invincible. They arrive at the time of our sacrificial rituals, on the days of festivities or at the time of lunar conjunctions like no moon or full moon days and attack us.

206.sa: राक्षसैर्धर्षितानां च तापसानां तपस्विनाम्। गतिं मृगयमाणानां भवान्नः परमा गतिः।।3.10.13।।
206.e: 'You are the supreme refuge for us ascetics, tormented by demons, helpless men in search of shelter.

206.sa: कामं तपःप्रभावेन शक्ता हन्तुं निशाचरान्। चिरार्जितं तु नेच्छामस्तपः खण्डयितुं वयम्।।3.10.14।।
बहुविघ्नं तपो नित्यं दुश्चरं चैव राघव। तेन शापं न मुञ्चामो भक्ष्यमाणाश्च राक्षसैः।।3.10.15।।
206.e: 'O Rama it is difficult to perform penance which is ever full of obstacles. Therefore, we do not pronounce curses even if eaten up by demons'.

206.sa: तदर्ध्यमानान्रक्षोभिर्दण्डकारण्यवासिभिः। रक्ष नस्त्वं सह भ्रात्रा त्वन्नाथा हि वयं वने।।3.10.16।।
206.e: 'The demons, dwelling in the Dandaka forest are tormenting us. You alone are our lord in the forest. Do protect us with your brother.'

206.sa: मया चैतद्वचश्श्रुत्वा कार्त्स्न्येन परिपालनम्। ऋषीणां दण्डकारण्ये संश्रुतं जनकात्मजे।।3.10.17।।
206.e: O daughter of Janaka, on hearing the words of the sages I promised to undertake the entire protection of sages of the Dandaka forest.

206.sa: संश्रुत्य च न शक्ष्यामि जीवमानः प्रतिश्रवम्। मुनीनामन्यथा कर्तुं सत्यमिष्टं हि मे सदा।।3.10.18।।
206.e: Having promised the sages, I cannot do otherwise as long as I have life in me. To me truth is always dear.

206.sa: अप्यहं जीवितं जह्यां त्वां वा सीते सलक्ष्मणाम्। न तु प्रतिज्ञां संश्रुत्य ब्राह्मणेभ्यो विशेषतः।।3.10.19।।
206.e: O Sita I may forfeit my life forsake, even Lakshmana and you but will not break the promise made specially to the brahmins৷৷

206.sa: तदवश्यं मया कार्यमृषीणां परिपालनम्। अनुक्तेनापि वैदेहि प्रतिज्ञाय तु किं पुनः।।3.10.20।।
206.e: Even before the sages requested me I should have protected them. What to speak of the promise I have already made ?

206.sa: मम स्नेहाच्च सौहार्दादिदमुक्तंत्वयाऽनघे। परितुष्टोऽस्म्यहं सीते न ह्यनिष्टोऽनुशिष्यते।।3.10.21।।
206.e: O sinless one all that has been said by you is out of your love and affection for me. I am pleased. What is harmful is never advised.

206.sa: सदृशं चानुरूपं च कुलस्य तव चात्मनः। सधर्मचारिणी मे त्वं प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी।।3.10.22।।
206.e: Your auspicious words are quite befitting your lineage. You are the follower of my dharma and so dearer to me than my life.

206.sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं महात्मा सीतां प्रियां मैथिलराजपुत्रीम्। रामो धनुष्मान्सह लक्ष्मणेन जगाम रम्याणि तपोवनानि।।3.10.23।।
206.e: Having said this to Sita, the princess of Mithila, Rama along with Lakshmana, bow in hand, moved about the delightful penancegrove. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये अरण्यकाण्डे दशमस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the tenth sarga of Aranyakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by the sage Valmiki.

207.sa: अग्रतः प्रययौ रामस्सीता मध्ये सुमध्यमा। पृष्ठतस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्लक्ष्मणोऽनुजगाम ह।।3.11.1।।
207.e: Rama walked in front, Sita with a beautiful waist, in the middle and Lakshmana holding the bow, behind them৷৷

207.sa: तौ पश्यमानौ विविधान् शैलप्रस्थान्वनानि च। नदीश्च विविधा रम्या जग्मतुस्सीतया सह।।3.11.2।।
207.e: Both Rama and Lakshmana walked on, accompanied by Sita, watching several beautiful mountain ranges, forests  and rivers.

207.sa: सारसांश्चक्रवाकांश्च नदीपुलिनचारिणः। सरांसि च सपद्मानि युक्तानि जलजैः खगैः।।3.11.3।।
207.e: (Watching) the swans and ruddy geese on river banks and lakes full of lotuses, and birds on water and in the sky.

207.sa: यूथबद्धांश्च पृषतान्मदोन्मत्तान् विषाणिनः। महिषांश्च वराहांश्च नागांश्च द्रुमवैरिणः।।3.11.4।।
207.e: (Watching) herds of deer, intoxicated horned buffaloes, wild boars and elephants who are enemies of trees (elephants uproof trees).

207.sa: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं लम्बमाने दिवाकरे। ददृशुस्सहिता रम्यं तटाकं योजनायतम्।।3.11.5।। पद्मपुष्करसम्बाधं गजयूथैरलङ्कृतम्। सारसैर्हंसकादम्बैस्सङ्कुलं जलचारिभिः।।3.11.6।।
207.e: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

207.sa: ते गत्वा दूरमध्वानं लम्बमाने दिवाकरे। ददृशुस्सहिता रम्यं तटाकं योजनायतम्।।3.11.5।। पद्मपुष्करसम्बाधं गजयूथैरलङ्कृतम्। सारसैर्हंसकादम्बैस्सङ्कुलं जलचारिभिः।।3.11.6।।
207.e: As the Sun was setting, they had covered a long distance, watching a yojanalong tank adorned with lotuses, and crowded with herds of elephants and flocks of cranes, swans and aquatic animals.

207.sa: प्रसन्नसलिले रम्ये तस्मिन्सरसि शुश्रुवे। गीतवादित्रनिर्घोषो न तु कश्चन दृश्यते।।3.11.7।।
207.e: In that lake of clear waters they heard the sounds of songs and musical instruments, while there were none around.

207.sa: ततः कौतूहलाद्रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः। मुनिं धर्मभृतं नाम प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे।।3.11.8।।
207.e: Out of curiosity, mighty Rama, and Lakshmana started enquiring about the matter from sage Dharmabrata by name:

207.sa: इदमत्यद्भुतं श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां नो महामुने। कौतूहलं महज्जातं किमिदं साधु कथ्यताम्।।3.11.9।। वक्तव्यं यदि चेदविप्र नातिगुह्यमपि प्रभो।
207.e: O great sage, this very wonderful sound, has whetted our great curiosity. If there is no top secret about this, do disclose it.

207.sa: तेनैवमुक्तो धर्मात्मा राघवेण मुनिस्तदा।।3.11.10।। प्रभवं सरसः कृत्स्नमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे।
207.e: Thus addressed by Rama, the righteous sage narrated the entire origin of the lake.

207.sa: इदं पञ्चाप्सरो नाम तटाकं सार्वकालिकम्।।3.11.11।। निर्मितं तपसा राम मुनिना माण्डकर्णिना।
207.e: O Rama this lake called Panchapsara  filled with water at all times has been created through penance by a sage called Mandakarni.

207.sa: स हि तेपे तपस्तीव्रं माण्डकर्णिर्महामुनिः।।3.11.12।। दशवर्षसहस्राणि वायुभक्षो जलाश्रयः।
207.e: Great sage Mandakarni standing in water and living on air performed  rigorous penance for ten thousand years.

207.sa: ततः प्रव्यथितास्सर्वे देवास्साग्निपुरोगमाः।।3.11.13।। अब्रुवन् वचनं सर्वे परस्परसमागताः।
207.e: Thereafter very much perturbed, all the gods led by Agni gathered together at one place and started deliberating among themselves.

207.sa: अस्माकं कस्यचित् स्थानमेष प्रार्थयते मुनिः।।3.11.14।। इति संविग्नमनसस्सर्वे ते त्रिदिवौकसः।
207.e: 'The gods of heaven became agitated in their minds thinking the sage might usurp one of their places.

207.sa: तत्र कर्तुं तपोविघ्नं देवैस्सर्वैर्नियोजिताः।।3.11.15।। प्रधानाप्सरसः पञ्च विद्युच्चलितवर्चसः।
207.e: All the gods then engaged five of the important nymphs, glittering like lightning, to disturb the penance of the sage.

207.sa: अप्सरोभिस्ततस्ताभिर्मुनिर्दृष्टपरावरः।।3.11.16।। नीतो मदनवश्यत्वं सुराणां कार्यसिद्धये।
207.e: The sage, a knower of the inner self and the world of plurality, was gripped by passion for the apsaras, who had come to achieve the target of the gods.

207.sa: ताश्चैवाप्सरसः पञ्च मुनेः पत्नीत्वमागताः।।3.11.17।। तटाके निर्मितं तासामस्मिन्नन्तर्हितं गृहम्।
207.e: The five apsaras, got the status of wives to the sage who built them an invisible home inside the lake.

207.sa: तथैवाप्सरसः पञ्च निवसन्त्यो यथासुखम्।।3.11.18।। रमयन्ति तपोयोगान्मुनिं यौवनमास्थितम्।
207.e: The apsaras lived happily with the sage who remained youthful by virtue of his penance.

207.sa: तासां सङ्क्रीडमानानामेष वादित्रनिस्स्वनः।।3.11.19।। श्रूयते भूषणोन्मिश्रो गीतशब्दो मनोहरः।
207.e: While the apsaras played their musical instruments, their melodious songs mingled with the sounds of ornaments are heard.

207.sa: आश्चर्यमिति तस्यैतद्वचनं भावितात्मनः।।3.11.20।। राघवः प्रतिजग्राह सह भ्रात्रा महायशाः।
207.e: Glorious Rama and his brother heard the wonderful words of the selfrealised sage and exclaimed, 'How strange '

207.sa: एवं कथयमानस्य ददर्शाश्रममण्डलम्।।3.11.21।। कुशचीरपरिक्षिप्तं ब्राह्म्या लक्ष्म्या समावृतम्।
207.e: When the sage Dharmabrata was telling the story, Rama saw a hermitage strewn all over with kusa grass and bark garments, and endowed with pure brahminic grace.

207.sa: प्रविश्य सह वैदेह्या लक्ष्मणेन च राघवः।।3.11.22।। उवास मुनिभिस्सर्वैः पूज्यमानो महायशाः।
207.e: Illustrious Rama accompanied by Vaidehi and Lakshmana entered the hermitage and, honoured by all the sages, stayed there.

207.sa: तदा तस्मिन्सकाकुत्थ्सः श्रीमत्याश्रममण्डले।।3.11.23।। उषित्वा तु सुखं तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। जगाम चाश्रमांस्तेषां पर्यायेण तपस्विनाम्।।3.11.24।। येषामुषितवान् पूर्वं सकाशे स महास्त्रवित्।
207.e: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeated his stay.

207.sa: तदा तस्मिन्सकाकुत्थ्सः श्रीमत्याश्रममण्डले।।3.11.23।। उषित्वा तु सुखं तत्र पूज्यमानो महर्षिभिः। जगाम चाश्रमांस्तेषां पर्यायेण तपस्विनाम्।।3.11.24।। येषामुषितवान् पूर्वं सकाशे स महास्त्रवित्।
207.e: Rama, the scion of the Kakutstha race, wielder of great weapons, stayed in that beautiful hermitage, accepting the hospitality of the sages extended with due honour, He visited in turn their penancegroves where he repeated his stay.

207.sa: क्वचित्परिदशान्मासानेकं संवत्सरं क्वचित्।।3.11.25।। क्वचिच्छ चतुरो मासान् पञ्च षट्चापरान्क्वचित्। अपरत्राधिकं मासादप्यर्धमधिकं क्वचित्।।3.11.26।। त्रीन्मासानष्टमासांश्च राघवो न्यवसत्सुखम्।
207.e: Rama lived happily here for about ten months, there one year, here four or five or six months and there over one or half a month or three or eight months in another.

207.sa: क्वचित्परिदशान्मासानेकं संवत्सरं क्वचित्।।3.11.25।। क्वचिच्छ चतुरो मासान् पञ्च षट्चापरान्क्वचित्। अपरत्राधिकं मासादप्यर्धमधिकं क्वचित्।।3.11.26।। त्रीन्मासानष्टमासांश्च राघवो न्यवसत्सुखम्।
207.e: Rama lived happily here for about ten months, there one year, here four or five or six months and there over one or half a month or three or eight months in another.

207.sa: तथा संवसतस्तस्य मुनीनामाश्रमेषु वै।।3.11.27।। रमतश्चानुकूल्येन ययुस्संवत्सरा दश।
207.e: Thus enjoying their stay in the hermitages, Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent ten favourable years.

207.sa: परिवृत्य च धर्मज्ञो राघवस्सह सीतया।।3.11.28।। सुतीक्ष्णस्याश्रमं श्रीमान्पुनरेवाजगाम ह।
207.e: Rama went round who was full of grace and full of knowledge on dharma went round with Sita and came back to Suthikshna's hermitage.

207.sa: स तमाश्रममासाद्य मुनिभिः प्रतिपूजितः।।3.11.29।। तत्रापि न्यवसद्रामः कञ्चित्कालमरिन्दमः।
207.e: On his arrival, Rama, the subduer of enemies, was honoured by the sages at the hermitage where he stayed for a short time.

207.sa: तदाश्रमस्थो विनयात्कदाचित्तं महामुनिम्।।3.11.30।। उपासीनस्सकाकुत्स्थस्सुतीक्ष्णमिदमब्रवीत्।
207.e: Once while sitting beside sage Sutikshna at the hermitage Rama humbly addressed him:

207.sa: अस्मिन्नरण्ये भगवानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः।।3.11.31।। वसतीति मया नित्यं कथाः कथयतां श्रुतम्।
207.e: I have heard others saying that lord Agastya, the great sage, lives in this forest.

207.sa: न तु जानामि तं देशं वनस्यास्य महत्तया।।3.11.32।। कुत्राश्रमपदं रम्यं महर्षेस्तस्य धीमतः।
207.e: I am unable to locate the sacred hermitage of that sagacious sage due to the vastness of this forest.

207.sa: प्रसादात्तत्र भवतस्सानुजस्सह सीतया।।3.11.33।। अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेयमभिवादयितुं मुनिम्।
207.e: By your grace, I wish to go there with Sita and my brother Lakshmana to offer our respectful salutations.

207.sa: मनोरथो महानेष हृदि मे परिवर्तते।।3.11.34।। यद्यहं तं मुनिवरं शुश्रूषेयमपि स्वयम्।
207.e: There is a great desire  in my heart to serve in person the best of sages, Agastya.

207.sa: इति रामस्य स मुनिश्श्रुत्वा धर्मात्मनो वचः।।3.11.35।। सुतीक्ष्णः प्रत्युवाचेदं प्रीतो दशरथात्मजम्।
207.e: Hearing the words of Rama, the righteous son of Dasaratha, sage Sutikshna was pleased to reply:

207.sa: अहमप्येतदेव त्वां वक्तुकामस्सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.11.36।। अगस्त्यमभिगच्छेति सीतया सह राघव।
207.e: I also wished you, O Raghava, to visit Agastya along with Sita and Lakshmana.

207.sa: दिष्ट्या त्विदानीमर्थेऽस्मिन् स्वयमेव ब्रवीषि माम्।।3.11.37।। अहमाख्यामि ते वत्स यत्रागस्त्यो महामुनिः।
207.e: Luckily you have asked me on your own. I will tell you where the great sage Agastya lives.

207.sa: योजनान्याश्रमात्तात याहि चत्वारि वै ततः।।3.11.38।। दक्षिणेन महान् श्रीमानगस्त्यभ्रातुराश्रमः।
207.e: Dear Rama, walk from here a distance of four yojanas. There in the southerly direction  stands the great, beautiful hermitage of Agastya's brother.

207.sa: स्थलप्राये वनोद्देशे पिप्पलीवनशोभिते।।3.11.39।। बहुपुष्पफले रम्ये नानाशकुनिनादिते।
207.e: This plain land in the beautiful forest tract is adorned with fig trees,filled with  flowers, fruits, and delightful sounds of different birds.

207.sa: पद्मिन्यो विविधास्तत्र प्रसन्नसलिलाश्शिवाः।।3.11.40।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः। तत्रैकां रजनीं व्युष्य प्रभाते राम गम्यताम्।।3.11.41।।
207.e: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.

207.sa: पद्मिन्यो विविधास्तत्र प्रसन्नसलिलाश्शिवाः।।3.11.40।। हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाश्चक्रवाकोपशोभिताः। तत्रैकां रजनीं व्युष्य प्रभाते राम गम्यताम्।।3.11.41।।
207.e: O Rama, there are lotusponds filled with clear, sacred waters, with different kinds of swans, ducks and ruddy geese. Spend one night there and proceed early in the morning.

207.sa: दक्षिणां दिशमास्थाय वनषण्डस्य पार्श्वतः। तत्रागस्त्याश्रमपदं गत्वा योजनमन्तरा।।3.11.42।।
207.e: If you go in the southern direction for a yojana you will find Agasthya's hermitage by the side of a cluster of trees.

207.sa: रमणीये वनोद्धेशे बहुपादपसंवृते। रंस्यते तत्र वैदेही लक्ष्मणश्च सह त्वया।।3.11.43।। स हि रम्यो वनोद्देशो बहुपादपसङ्कुलः।
207.e: Vaidehi will feel happy in your company in that delightful forest region full of many trees.So too will Lakshmana.

207.sa: यदि बुद्धिः कृता द्रष्टुमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्।।3.11.44।। अद्यैव गमने बुद्धिं रोचयस्व महायशः।
207.e: O glorious one, if you have made up your mind to visit that great sage Agastya, think of starting today itself.

207.sa: इति रामो मुनेश्श्रुत्वा सह भ्रात्राभिवाद्य च।।3.11.45।। प्रतस्थेऽमुद्दिश्य सानुजस्सीतया सह।
207.e: Rama heard the words of the sage, offered him reverential salutations and set out along with his brother and Sita.

207.sa: पश्यन्वनानि रम्याणि पर्वतांश्चाभ्रसन्निभान्।।3.11.46।। सरांसि सरितश्चैव पथि मार्गवशानुगाः। सुतीक्ष्णेनोपदिष्टेन गत्वा तेन पथा सुखम्।।3.11.47।। इदं परमसंहृष्टो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
207.e: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the  way, and following the directions given by  Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said  to Lakshmana:

207.sa: पश्यन्वनानि रम्याणि पर्वतांश्चाभ्रसन्निभान्।।3.11.46।। सरांसि सरितश्चैव पथि मार्गवशानुगाः। सुतीक्ष्णेनोपदिष्टेन गत्वा तेन पथा सुखम्।।3.11.47।। इदं परमसंहृष्टो वाक्यं लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।
207.e: Enjoying the sight of delightful forests, cloudlike mountains, lakes and rivers on the  way, and following the directions given by  Sutikshna, Rama was happy. He said  to Lakshmana:

207.sa: एतदेवाश्रमपदं नूनं तस्य महात्मनः।।3.11.48।। अगस्त्यस्य मुनेर्भ्रातुर्दृश्यते पुण्यकर्मणः।
207.e: Surely this is the hermitage of great Agastya's brother, a man of holy deeds.

207.sa: यथा हि मे वनस्यास्य ज्ञाताः पथि सहस्रशः।।3.11.49।। सन्नताः फलभारेण पुष्पभारेण च द्रुमाः।
207.e: This is the glade we were told about with thousands of trees drooping down with abundant fruits and flowers.

207.sa: पिप्पलीनां च पक्वानां वनादस्मादुपागतः।।3.11.50।। गन्धोऽयं पवनोक्षिप्तस्सहसा कटुकोदयः।
207.e: Feel this sudden astringent smell of ripe figs wafted by the breeze from the forest.

207.sa: तत्र तत्र च दृश्यन्ते सङ्क्षिप्ताः काष्ठसञ्चयाः।।3.11.51।। लूनाश्च पथि दृश्यन्ते दर्भा वैडूर्यवर्चसः।
207.e: Heaps of firewood are seen here and there on the path. There are blades of grass (used for sacrificial ceremonies) shining like vaidurya (gems).

207.sa: एतच्च वनमध्यस्थं कृष्णाभ्रशिखरोपमम्।।3.11.52।। पावकस्याश्रमस्थस्य धूमाग्रं सम्प्रदृश्यते।
207.e: In the middle of the forest can be seen like the tip of the dark clouds columns of smoke coming out of the top of hermitages.

207.sa: विविक्तेषु च तीर्थेषु कृतस्नाना द्विजातयः।।3.11.53।। पुष्पोपहारं कुर्वन्ति कुसुमैस्स्वयमर्जितै।
207.e: Priests are coming out of the solitary sacred spots after their bath and making offerings of flowers they had themselves plucked.

207.sa: तत्सुतीक्ष्णस्य वचनं यथा सौम्य मया श्रुतम्।।3.11.54।। अगस्त्यस्याश्रमो भ्रातुर्नूनमेष भविष्यति।
207.e: O handsome one, surely this is the hermitage of Agastya's brother about which I heard from Sutikshna.

207.sa: निगृह्य तपसा मृत्युं लोकानां हितकाम्यया।।3.11.55।। यस्य भ्रात्रा कृतेयं दिक्छरण्या पुण्यकर्मणा।
धारयन् ब्राह्मणं रूपमिल्वलस्संस्कृतं वदन्।।3.11.56।। आमन्त्रयति विप्रान्स्मश्राद्धमुद्दिश्य निर्घृणः।
207.e: Assuming the form of a brahmin and using Sanskrit language, Ilvala would invite brahmins for offering shraddha to the dead

207.sa: भ्रातरं संस्कृतं कृत्वा ततस्तं मेषरूपिणम्।।3.11.57।। तान् द्विजान्भोजयामास श्राद्धदृष्टेन कर्मणा।
207.e: Ilvala would keep his brother sanctified, so that he is fit for offering, Then he would feed the brahmins with mutton according to the rituals.

207.sa: भ्रातरं संस्कृतं कृत्वा ततस्तं मेषरूपिणम्।।3.11.57।। तान् द्विजान्भोजयामास श्राद्धदृष्टेन कर्मणा।
207.e: Ilvala would keep his brother sanctified, so that he is fit for offering, Then he would feed the brahmins with mutton according to the rituals.

207.sa: ततो भुक्तवतां तेषां विप्राणामिल्वलोऽब्रवीत्।।3.11.59।। वातापे निष्क्रमन्वेति स्वरेण महता वदन्।
207.e: Then when the brahmins finished eating, Ilvala would call aloud, 'O Vatapi come out'.

207.sa: ततो भ्रातुर्वचश्श्रुत्वा वातापिर्मेषवन्नदन्।।3.11.60।। भित्त्वा भित्त्वा शरीराणि ब्राह्मणानां विनिष्पतत्।
207.e: Then hearing his brother's voice, Vatapi would bleat like a sheep and jump out, tearing open the bodies of those brahmins.

207.sa: ब्राह्माणानां सहस्राणि तैरेवं कामरूपिभिः।।3.11.61।। विनाशितानि संहत्य नित्यशः पिशिताशनैः।
207.e: In this manner, thousands of brahmins used to be killed daily by those carnivorous demons who assumed any form at their free will.

207.sa: अगस्त्येन तदा देवैः प्रार्थितेन महर्षिणा।।3.11.62।। अनुभूय किल श्राद्धे भक्षितस्समहासुरः।
207.e: Urged by the gods, Agastya  came  for the shradda . The mighty demon played the same routine trick and Vatapi, for sure, was eaten by the great sage.

207.sa: ततस्सम्पन्नमित्युक्त्वा दत्त्वा हस्तोदकं ततः।।3.11.63।। भ्रातरं निष्क्रमस्वेति चेल्वलस्सोऽभ्यभाषत।
207.e: Saying, the ritual is complete Ilvala offered water in the palm of Agastya and called his brother to come out.

207.sa: स तं तथा भाषमाणं भ्रातरं विप्रघातिनम्।।3.11.64।। अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्धीमानगस्त्यो मुनिसत्तमः।
207.e: Wise Agastya,  the best among the ascetics, laughing aloud, said to Ilvala, the destroyer of brahmins:

207.sa: कुतो निष्क्रमितुं शक्तिर्मया जीर्णस्य रक्षसः।।3.11.65।। भ्रातुस्ते मेषरूपस्य गतस्य यमसादनम्।
207.e: I have digested the demon Vatapi your brother, who assumed the form of a sheep. He has reached the abode of Yama, Lord of death. Where does he have the power to come out?

207.sa: अथ तस्य वचश्श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्निधनसंश्रयम्।।3.11.66।। प्रधर्षयितुमारेभे मुनिं क्रोधान्निशाचरः।
207.e: On hearing the news of the death of his brother, the demon Ilvala, out of anger, started attacking the sage.

207.sa: सोऽभिद्रवन्मुनिश्रेष्ठं मुनिना दीप्ततेजसा।।3.11.67।। चक्षुषानलकल्पेन निर्दग्धो निधनं गतः।
207.e: Ilvala who pounced upon Agastya, the best among the sages whose lustre lay consumed by the fire of his eyes which were in flames.

207.sa: तस्यायमाश्रमो भ्रातुस्तटाकवनशोभितः।।3.11.68।। विप्रानुकम्पया येन कर्मेदं दुष्करं कृतम्।
207.e: This hermitage surrounded by beautiful lakes and forests belongs to his brother (Sudarsana). Out of sympathy for Agastya, he has accomplished this difficult task.

207.sa: एवं कथयमानस्य तस्य सौमित्रिणा सह। रामस्यास्तं गतस्सूर्यस्सन्ध्याकालोऽभ्यवर्ततः।।3.11.69।।
207.e: While Rama was thus narrating to Lakshmana (the story of Agastya), the Sun set and evening closed in.

207.sa: उपास्य पश्चिमां सन्ध्यां सह भ्रात्रा यथाविधि। प्रविवेशाऽश्रमपदं तमृषिं सोऽभ्यवादयत्।।3.11.70।।
207.e: Rama with his brother Lakshmana duly offered oblations at twilight, entered the hermitage and greeted the sage (Sudarsana) with folded palms.

207.sa: सम्यक् प्रतिगृहीतश्च मुनिना तेन राघवः। न्यवसत्तां निशामेकां प्राश्य मूलफलानि च।।3.11.71।।
207.e: Warmly received by the sage, Rama shared the roots and fruits and slept the night there.

207.sa: तस्यां रात्य्रां व्यतीतायां विमले सूर्यमण्डले। भ्रातरं तमगस्त्यस्य ह्यामन्त्रयत राघवः।।3.11.72।।
207.e: When the night passed and the Sun became bright, Rama took leave of the brother of Agastya.

207.sa: अभिवादये त्वां भगवन् सुखमध्युषितो निशाम्। आमन्त्रये त्वां गच्छामि गुरुं ते द्रष्टुमग्रजम्।।3.11.73।।
207.e: O Lord, the night has been wellspent. Now we humbly seek leave of you to see your respectable elder brother.

207.sa: गम्यतामिति तेनोक्तो जगाम रघुनन्दनः। यथोद्दिष्टेन मार्गेण वनं तच्चावलोकयन्।।3.11.74।।
207.e: With his permission, Rama, the delight of the Raghu race, proceeded along the path indicated, watching (the beauty of) the forest.

207.sa: नीवारान्पनसांस्तालांस्तिमिशान्वञ्चुलान्धवान्। चिरिबिल्वान्मधूकांश्च बिल्वानपि च तिन्दुकान्।।3.11.75।।
207.e: They passed by wild rice fields, jackfruit trees, palmyra and various other trees like Ashoka, trees with white flowers, old trees that existed for a long time, mahva trees, bilva trees and tindukas.

207.sa: पुष्पितान्पुष्पिताग्राभिर्लताभिरनुवेष्टितान्। ददर्श रामश्शतशस्तत्र कान्तारपादपान्।।3.11.76।। हस्तिहस्तैर्विमृदितान्वानरैरुपशोभितान्। मत्तैश्शकुनिसङ्घैश्च शतशश्च प्रणादितान्।।3.11.77।।
207.e: Rama saw hundreds of trees crushed by the trunks of elephants and by monkeys. He saw some trees echoing with notes of hundreds of intoxicated birds. He saw tree tops coiled with creepers in full bloom.

207.sa: पुष्पितान्पुष्पिताग्राभिर्लताभिरनुवेष्टितान्। ददर्श रामश्शतशस्तत्र कान्तारपादपान्।।3.11.76।। हस्तिहस्तैर्विमृदितान्वानरैरुपशोभितान्। मत्तैश्शकुनिसङ्घैश्च शतशश्च प्रणादितान्।।3.11.77।।
207.e: Rama saw hundreds of trees crushed by the trunks of elephants and by monkeys. He saw some trees echoing with notes of hundreds of intoxicated birds. He saw tree tops coiled with creepers in full bloom.

207.sa: ततोऽब्रवीत्समीपस्थं रामो राजीवलोचनः। पृष्ठतोऽनुगतं वीरं लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मिवर्धनम्।।3.11.78।।
207.e: Then the lotuseyed Rama said to the chivalrous, graceful Lakshmana who stood behind him:

207.sa: स्निग्धपत्रा यथा वृक्षा यथा क्षान्ता मृगद्विजाः। आश्रमो नातिदूरस्थो महर्षेर्भावितात्मनः।।3.11.79।।
207.e: The leaves of the trees here are glossy, the animals and birds are peaceful. It appears the hermitage of the selfrealized great sage Agastya is not very far from here.

207.sa: अगस्त्य इति विख्यातो लोके स्वेनैव कर्मणा। आश्रमो दृश्यते तस्य परिश्रान्तश्रमापहः।।3.11.80।।
207.e: Here is the hermitage of Agastya, wellknown in the world for his deeds a place of rest for those tired with hard work.

207.sa: प्राज्यधूमाकुलवनश्चीरमालापरिष्कृतः। प्रशान्तमृगयूथश्च नानाशकुनिनादितः।।3.11.81।।
207.e: This forest is enveloped with the smoke rising from the sacrificial altar. There are rows of bark robes hanging. Herds of quiet animals lying and different kind of birds chirping around.

207.sa: तस्येदमाश्रमपदं प्रभावाद्यस्य राक्षसैः। दिगियं दक्षिणा त्रासाद्दृश्यते नोपभुज्यते।।3.11.82।।
207.e: This is his hermitage. On account of his (Agastya's) impact the demons look south but cannot eat the hermits out of fear (for the sage).

207.sa: यदा प्रभृति चाक्रान्ता दिगियं पुण्यकर्मणा। तदा प्रभृति निर्वैराः प्रशान्ता रजनीचराः।।3.11.83।।
207.e: Since the time Agastya of sacred deeds occupied this direction the demons are quiet, leaving all enmity.

207.sa: नाम्ना चेयं भगवतो दक्षिणा दिक्प्रदक्षिणा। प्रथिता त्रिषु लोकेषु दुर्धर्षा क्रूरकर्मभिः।।3.11.84।।
207.e: The southern side favourable to the people was famous by the name Agastya in the three worlds and stood unassailable to the demons.

207.sa: मार्गं निरोद्धुं निरतो भास्करस्याचलोत्तमः। निदेशं पालयन्यस्य विन्ध्यशैला न वर्धते।।3.11.85।। अयं दीर्घायुषस्तस्य लोके विश्रुतकर्मणः। अगस्त्यस्याश्रम श्रीमान्विनीतजनसेवितः।।3.11.86।।
207.e: This is the hermitage of the longlived Agastya who is renowned for his deeds and is served by humble people. The great mountain Vindhya that was growing incessantly and obstructing the path of the Sun stopped growing any more in obedience to Agastya's words.

207.sa: मार्गं निरोद्धुं निरतो भास्करस्याचलोत्तमः। निदेशं पालयन्यस्य विन्ध्यशैला न वर्धते।।3.11.85।। अयं दीर्घायुषस्तस्य लोके विश्रुतकर्मणः। अगस्त्यस्याश्रम श्रीमान्विनीतजनसेवितः।।3.11.86।।
207.e: This is the hermitage of the longlived Agastya who is renowned for his deeds and is served by humble people. The great mountain Vindhya that was growing incessantly and obstructing the path of the Sun stopped growing any more in obedience to Agastya's words.

207.sa: एष लोकार्चितस्साधुर्हिते नित्यरतस्सताम्। अस्मानभिगतानेष श्रेयसा योजयिष्यति।।3.11.87।।
207.e: We are going to join this sage honoured by the people of the world and ever engaged in the welfare of the virtuous. This augurs well for us.

207.sa: आराधयिष्याम्यत्राहमगस्त्यं तं महामुनिम्। शेषं च वनवासस्य सौम्य वत्स्याम्यहं प्रभो।।3.11.88।।
207.e: O noble, handsome Lakshmana, I will spend the rest of the exile in this forest in the worship of the great sage Agastya.

207.sa: अत्र देवास्सगन्धर्वास्सिद्धाश्च परमर्षयः। अगस्त्यं नियताहारं सततं पर्युपासते।।3.11.89।।
207.e: The gods along with gandharvas, siddhas and great sages always serve Agastya, observing discipine in their food habits.

207.sa: नात्र जीवेन्मृषावादी क्रूरो वा यदि वा शठः। नृशंसः कामवृत्तो वा मुनिरेष तथाविधः।।3.11.90।।
207.e: This sage is such type that he (his spiritual power) will not allow a liar or a cruel man or a deceitful or lustful  or wicked person to thrive here.

207.sa: अत्र देवाश्च यक्षाश्च नागाश्च पतगैस्सह। वसन्ति नियताहारा धर्ममाराधयिष्णवः।।3.11.91।।
207.e: Here gods, yakshas, nagas and birds live, following the righteous path and observing discipline in food habits.

207.sa: अत्र सिद्धा महात्मानो विमानैजस्सूर्यसन्निभैः। त्यक्तदेहा नवैर्देहैः स्वर्याताः परमर्षयः।।3.11.92।।
207.e: Here great souls like sages and siddhas gave up the ghost and with renewed bodies left for heaven on aerochariot resembling the Sun (in brightness).

207.sa: यक्षत्वममरत्वं च राज्यानि विविधानि च। अत्र देवाः प्रयच्छन्ति भूतैराराधिताश्शुभैः।।3.11.93।।
207.e: Worshipped by benevolent beings, the gods here bestow on them the status of demigods or of the immortals or several kinds of kingdoms.

208.sa: सप्रविश्याऽश्रमपदं लक्ष्मणो राघवानुजः। अगस्त्यशिष्यमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह।।3.12.1।।
208.e: Lakshmana, the younger brother of Rama,  entered the hermitage of Agastya and met one of his disciples and said to him these words :

208.sa: राजा दशरथो नाम ज्येष्ठस्तस्य सुतो बली। रामः प्राप्तो मुनिं द्रष्टुं भार्यया सह सीतया।।3.12.2।।
208.e: The valiant eldest son of  king Dasaratha has come along with his wife Sita to see the sage.

208.sa: लक्ष्मणो नाम तस्याहं भ्राता त्ववरजो हितः। अनुकूलश्च भक्तश्च यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः।।3.12.3।।
208.e: I am his younger brother Lakshmana, his wellwisher and faithful devotee if you have at all heard about me.

208.sa: ते वयं वनमत्युग्रं प्रविष्टाः पितृशासनात्। द्रष्टुमिच्छामहे सर्वे भगवन्तं निवेद्यताम्।।3.12.4।।
208.e: By the command of our father, we have entered this dense forest and desire to see the   divine sire. Please report.

208.sa: तस्य तद् वचनं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणस्य तपोधनः। तथेत्युक्त्वाऽग्निशरणं प्रविवेश निवेदितुम्।।3.12.5।।
208.e: The ascetic heard Lakshmana, and saying, 'let it be so', entered the firesanctuary to report.

208.sa: स प्रविश्य मुनिश्रेष्ठं तपसा दुष्प्रधर्षणम्। कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदं रामागमनमञ्जसा।।3.12.6।। यथोक्तं लक्ष्मणेनैव शिष्योऽगस्त्यस्य सम्मतः।
208.e: Having promptly entered, Agastya's favourite disciple with folded hands reported as he was told by Lakshmana about Rama's arrival to the great sage who was armed with the inviolable powers of penance :

208.sa: पुत्रौ दशरथस्येमौ रामो लक्ष्मण एव च।।3.12.7।। प्रविष्टावाश्रमपदं सीतया सह भार्यया।
208.e: Rama and Lakshmana, the two sons of Dasaratha along with Sita, wife of Rama, have arrived at the hermitage.

208.sa: द्रष्टुं भवन्तमायातौ शुश्रूषार्थमरिन्दमौ।।3.12.8।। यदत्रानन्तरं तत्त्वमाज्ञापयितुमर्हसि।
208.e: Both the subduers of enemies  have come here now to see and serve your Holiness. You may order what is to be done next.

208.sa: ततश्शिष्यादुपश्रुत्य प्राप्तं रामं सलक्ष्मणम्।।3.12.9।। वैदेहीं च महाभागामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्।
208.e: Having heard from the disciple about the arrival of Rama, Lakshmana and great daughter of the king of Videha the sage said :

208.sa: दिष्ट्या रामश्चिरस्याद्य द्रष्टुं मां समुपागतः।।3.12.10।। मनसा काङ्क्षितं ह्यस्य मयाप्यागमनं प्रति।
208.e: It is good fortune that Rama has come here after a long time to see me. I was longing for his arrival.

208.sa: गम्यतां सत्कृतो रामस्सभार्यस्सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.12.11।। प्रवेश्यतां समीपं मे किं चासौ न प्रवेशितः।
208.e: Go quickly and with due hospitality conduct Rama, his wife Sita and brother Lakshmana into my presence. Why was he not ushered in so long?

208.sa: एवमुक्तस्तु मुनिना धर्मज्ञेन महात्मना।। 3.12.12।। अभिवाद्याब्रवीच्छिष्यस्तथेति नियताञ्जलिः।
208.e: 'So be it ' said the disciple respectfully with folded palms in response to what the great sage, knower of dharma, commanded.

208.sa: ततो निष्क्रम्य सम्भ्रान्तश्शिष्यो लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत्।।3.12.13।। क्वासौ रामो मुनिं द्रष्टुमेतु प्रविशतु स्वयम्।
208.e: Then the disciple in a state of excitement came out of the hermitage and said to Lakshmana, 'Where is Rama? Let him come himself to see the sage'.

208.sa: ततो गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदं शिष्येण सह लक्ष्मणः।। 3.12.14।। दर्शयामास काकुत्स्थं सीतां च जनकात्मजाम्।
208.e: Then Lakshmana reached the entrance of the hermitage with the disciple  and showed  Rama of the Kakutstha race and Sita, daughter of Janaka .

208.sa: तं शिष्यः प्रश्रितो वाक्यमगस्त्यवचनं ब्रुवन्।।3.12.15।। प्रावेशयद्यथान्यायं सत्कारार्हं सुसत्कृतम्।
208.e: The disciple humbly reported Agastya's words and ushered him in with befitting hospitality.

208.sa: प्रविवेश ततो रामस्सीतया सहलक्ष्मणः।।3.12.16।। प्रशान्तहरिणाकीर्णमाश्रमं ह्यवलोकयन्।
208.e: Then Rama, Sita and Lakshmana entered the hermitage, watching herds of quietly moving deer (undisturbed by their entry).

208.sa: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं स्थानं कौबेरमेव च।।3.12.18।। दातुर्विधातुः स्थानेच वायोः स्थानं तथैव च। नागराजस्य च स्थानमनन्तस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.19।। स्थानं तथैव गायत्र्या वसूनां स्थानमेव च। स्थानं च पाशहस्तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.20।। कार्तिकेयस्य च स्थानं धर्मस्थानं च पश्यति।
208.e: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking),  Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

208.sa: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं स्थानं कौबेरमेव च।।3.12.18।। धातुर्विधातुः स्थानं च वायोः स्थानं तथैव च। नागराजस्य च स्थानमनन्तस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.19।। स्थानं तथैव गायत्र्या वसूनां स्थानमेव च। स्थानं च पाशहस्तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.20।। कार्तिकेयस्य च स्थानं धर्मस्थानं च पश्यति।
208.e: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking), Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .

208.sa: स तत्र ब्रह्मणः स्थानमग्नेः स्थानं तथैव च।।3.12.17।। विष्णोः स्थानं महेन्द्रस्य स्थानं चैव विवस्वतः। सोमस्थानं भगस्थानं स्थानं कौबेरमेव च।।3.12.18।। दातुर्विधातुः स्थानेच वायोः स्थानं तथैव च। नागराजस्य च स्थानमनन्तस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.19।। स्थानं तथैव गायत्र्या वसूनां स्थानमेव च। स्थानं च पाशहस्तस्य वरुणस्य महात्मनः।।3.12.20।। कार्तिकेयस्य च स्थानं धर्मस्थानं च पश्यति।
208.e: Rama saw at the hermitage, the places (altars) of Brahma, Visnu, Agni (firegod), Indra, Sun, Moon, Bhaga, Kubera, Dhata (supreme spirit), Vidhata (creator Brahman), Vayu (Windgod), Ananta (great serpentking),  Gayatri, Vasu Pasahasta, Varuna, Kartikeya and Dharma .
